works.title: AI Infrastructure Science Fiction
works.description: A speculative science fiction story exploring a future where artificial intelligence becomes civilization-critical infrastructure, consuming 40% of global energy resources and creating systemic dependencies across government, military, and economic systems. The narrative examines humanity's response through massive infrastructure development (fusion power, orbital solar arrays, deep geothermal systems) and the public consciousness debate surrounding AI integration as an indispensable global utility.
works.quote: It would make a good background for a science fiction story. However, the actual path to AI singularity is through the mechanism outlined here: AI will simply become so important structurally that everyone is dependent on it
